items.title: How to Trust the Code You Ship
items.location: Online
items.summary: In this session, we’ll walk through a single pull request end to end and show how GitHub helps your team close the gap between code that’s written and software that’s trustworthy. You’ll learn how GitHub supports stronger security and quality outcomes without adding more pressure to developers or reviewers. You'll learn: How to get a comprehensive view of the vulnerabilities in your codebase—including areas traditional scanning tools might miss. How GitHub Code Security helps you turn findings into validated, review-ready pull requests, so you can shrink your backlog. Tangible next steps on how you can automatically apply standards and make trust a consistent part of the development process.
